integrity: Proof uses infinite-spectrum and unique positive spherical measures; symbolic identities and finite Gram tests provide supplementary verification but do not prove the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Infinite regular trees of degree at least three, ordered geometric scales 0<s<r<1 and nonnegative subtraction coefficient only. No finite-site strictness assertion at the unique atomic-collapse boundary. The classification uses a published radial spherical Bochner theorem and is not independently audited.
title: A sharp two-scale radial covariance cone on homogeneous trees and its atomic spectral collapse
